SUMMARY OF EMERGENCY RESPONSE PREPARATION PLAN 
DOCUMENT PREPARED: 11TH May 2025 
In case of emergencies occurring during working hours, be it at the yard or on the road, the 
authority to be notified is the Operations Manager through cell phone number 
0724768604 or 0710888240. 
The company is committed to ensuring the highest standards in transportation and 
distribution of Petroleum products by ensuring that there prevails a Healthy and Safe 
working environment. 
Company Drivers are trained on:- 
a) Recognition and/or identification of risks, which may include spillages, leakages, 
fires, among others. 
b) Ranking and/or evaluation of risks 
c) Responding to significant risks 
d) Reaction plan 
e) Reporting and/or monitoring risks 
Apart from the above mentioned, emergency drills are held quarterly with emphasis laid 
upon emergency preparedness plan. 
On occurrence of an emergency, the company policy is that only trained personnel are allowed 
to remain behind and tackle it, whereas the rest are evacuated to a designated assembly point 
and a roll call be taken. 
Some of the measures to mitigate emergencies include: 
1. Spilled Product 
 
In case of fire, cover spilled product with foam blanket until it is extinguished. 
 
Remove the spilled product and clean area with water. 
 
2. Truck Fire 
 
In case of fire on the truck, driver should use the powder extinguishers that 
are mounted and accessible. 
 
 
 
Always dedicated and devoted 

3. Truck Breakdown 
Move truck to the most convenient place for other road users 
Switch on hazard Lights 
Truck must not be left unattended 
Contact the Operations manager 
4. Medical emergency 
Perform First aid where possible 
. 
Rushed patient to the nearest medical facility. 
Emergency Contacts 
I. Fire 
Call Lodwar Fire station emergency line 0800721681 
 
2. Accident 
Call Kenya Police Service and Ambulance emergency line 999/112/911 
 
5. Emergency Equipments 
Manual Siren 
Dry powder extinguisher 
Foam Compound 
First Aid Kit 
Prepared, approved and signed on 11th May 2025
